%macro run_functs_compilation(
   sas_path = _NONE_
 , cmp_path = _NONE_
 , cmp_lib  = _NONE_
 , prefix   = %str()
 , contains = %str()
 , print    = Y
 , sendmail = N
 , mailaddr = %str()
 , debug    = N 
   );

   %* If debug mode, start macro trace: ;
   %if %upcase(&debug.) eq Y %then %do;
      %m_utl_print_mtrace(start)
   %end;

   options fullstimer;

   %m_adm_compile_functs(
      indir    = &sas_path.
    , outdir   = &cmp_path.
    , outlib   = &cmp_lib.
    , prefix   = &prefix.
    , contains = &contains.
    , print    = &print.
    , sendmail = &sendmail.
    , mailaddr = &mailaddr.
    , debug    = &debug.
      );

   options nofullstimer;

   %put _global_;

   %* If debug mode, finish macro trace: ;
   %if %upcase(&debug.) eq Y %then %do;
      %m_utl_print_mtrace(end)
   %end;

%mend run_functs_compilation;

   sas_path = &APPL_FUNC.

    , debug = &debug.
      )

   %m_log_set_options(
      mode  = RESET
    , token = &token.
    , debug = &debug.
      )

   %put _global_;

   %* If debug mode, finish macro trace: ;
   %if %upcase(&debug.) eq Y %then %do;
      %m_utl_print_mtrace(end)
